title: V01-C14 Parameters and Return Values Production Packet

assessment_alignment.acceptance_evidence: A before/after interface analysis that removes unused, duplicated, derivable, or hidden inputs; an explicit return-value model replacing hidden output; a parameter-to-local-to-return trace; and normal, boundary, invalid, mutation, and missing-argument tests.

accessibility_requirements: Binding tables label parameter positions and evaluated argument values.
Data-flow diagrams include numbered text traces.
Turkish terms include English only at first meaningful use.
Code comments and explanations are Turkish.
known_risks: Parameter and argument may be conflated.
Missing JavaScript arguments may silently become undefined.
Default parameters may mask invalid caller data.
Primitive reassignment may be confused with object-property mutation.
Long parameter lists may expose unrelated responsibilities.
Print, mutation, and return may be confused as one output channel.
Multiple results may use inconsistent shapes.
